test_cases.title: Workflow startup creates topic directory and initializes state
test_cases.description: Verify /coding-workflow command creates topic directory, initializes state with currentPhase=1, and renders TUI widget
steps: Verify TUI widget shows Phase 1 as current

test_cases.title: Phase 1 context injection contains brainstorming skill only
test_cases.description: Verify before_agent_start injects only xyz-harness-brainstorming skill content, no other phase skills
steps: Check before_agent_start injection contains [CODING WORKFLOW — STRICT MODE]
Verify injection contains brainstorming skill content
Verify injection does NOT contain writing-plans, phase-dev, phase-test, or phase-pr skill content

test_cases.title: Concurrent workflow startup is rejected
test_cases.description: Verify starting a second workflow when one is already active returns an error
steps: Verify error message about existing active workflow

test_cases.title: Gate tool rejects wrong phase number
test_cases.description: Verify coding-workflow-gate rejects phase number that doesn't match current phase

test_cases.title: Gate check passes when deliverables are complete
test_cases.description: Verify gate-check.py returns PASS when all deliverables exist and have correct YAML frontmatter
steps: Prepare complete Phase 1 deliverables (spec.md + spec_review with verdict=pass, must_fix=0)
Verify gate passes and review subagent is dispatched

test_cases.title: Gate check fails with specific error items
test_cases.description: Verify gate-check.py failure returns specific items that AI can fix
steps: Verify error contains specific failure items
Fix the issue and retry gate

test_cases.title: Review subagent dispatches with correct model and system prompt
test_cases.description: Verify review subagent uses taskComplexity=medium, expert-reviewer skill as system prompt
steps: Verify subagent spawn args include --model resolved from medium complexity
Verify system prompt file contains expert-reviewer skill content
Verify output file path follows {topicDir}/changes/reviews/spec_review_v{N}.md pattern

test_cases.title: Review must_fix loop creates versioned files
test_cases.description: Verify review with must_fix > 0 creates v1, then after fix creates v2
steps: First gate call: review returns must_fix=2 (creates spec_review_v1.md)
Second gate call: review returns must_fix=0 (creates spec_review_v2.md)

test_cases.title: Retrospect subagent dispatches after review passes
test_cases.description: Verify retrospect subagent runs after review must_fix=0, using harness-retrospect agent as system prompt

test_cases.title: Phase start tool transitions to next phase
test_cases.description: Verify coding-workflow-phase-start increments currentPhase and triggers compact
steps: After Phase 1 gate passes, call coding-workflow-phase-start()
Verify compact() was called with customInstructions
Verify new phase skill is injected after compact

test_cases.title: Phase start rejects if gate not passed
test_cases.description: Verify calling phase-start before gate passes returns error

test_cases.title: Compact failure does not block phase transition
test_cases.description: Verify that if compact() fails, new phase instructions are still injected
steps: Verify pi.sendUserMessage is still called with new phase instructions

test_cases.title: TUI widget shows correct phase progress
test_cases.description: Verify widget displays all 5 phases with correct status icons

test_cases.title: Footer status shows phase number
test_cases.description: Verify ctx.ui.setStatus shows 'Phase N/5'

test_cases.title: Phase 5 injection includes no-merge constraint
test_cases.description: Verify Phase 5 before_agent_start includes CRITICAL RULE about not merging PR
steps: Check injection contains 'MUST NOT merge the PR'
Check injection contains 'only create the PR, verify CI passes, produce evidence'

test_cases.title: Phase 5 completion returns done message without phase-start
test_cases.description: Verify Phase 5 gate pass returns completion message, does not require phase-start
steps: Verify tool returns 'All phases completed' or similar
Verify no phase-start call is needed

test_cases.title: State recovery after session resume
test_cases.description: Verify workflow state is correctly restored after /resume
steps: Verify phaseResults has Phase 1 and 2 as passed

test_cases.title: Abort kills active subprocesses and clears state
test_cases.description: Verify /coding-workflow-abort kills running subagent processes and resets state

test_cases.title: New workflow can start after abort
test_cases.description: Verify a new workflow can be started after aborting the previous one
steps: Verify new workflow initializes correctly with currentPhase=1

test_cases.title: Subagent spawn failure returns retryable error
test_cases.description: Verify spawn error (ENOENT) is caught and returns clear error message
steps: Trigger gate check with review dispatch
Verify error message mentions spawn failure
Verify error is retryable (workflow not stuck)

test_cases.title: Tool renderCall and renderResult display correct information
test_cases.description: Verify custom rendering shows phase number, topic, and status
steps: Verify renderCall shows 'Phase 1 Gate Check' + topicDir
Verify renderResult shows pass/fail icon and summary

test_cases.title: Workflow status command shows current progress
test_cases.description: Verify /coding-workflow-status displays topic, current phase, and passed phases
steps: Verify notify shows topic name, current phase, passed phases

test_cases.title: Full 5-phase workflow completes end-to-end
test_cases.description: Execute complete workflow from Phase 1 through Phase 5, verifying all transitions and deliverables
steps: Complete Phase 1 (spec) → gate → review → retrospect → phase-start
Complete Phase 2 (plan) → gate → review → retrospect → phase-start
Complete Phase 3 (dev) → gate → review → retrospect → phase-start
Complete Phase 4 (test) → gate → review → retrospect → phase-start
Verify all review files exist with correct version numbers
